newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Thursday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Thursday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady to $1.00 per cwt higher in a limited test. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers.
Confirmed - 2,300 Last Week - Holiday Year Ago - 82,200 Wk
to Date - 113,500 Last Week - 78,700 Year Ago - 108,500

Sales reported on 1,400 slaughter steers and 900 heifers; 113,500 head confirmed for week to date which includes 27,800 formulated and 100 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
